Acknowledgement.title: Acknowledgement
Acknowledgement.description: A run's post-commit acknowledgement that a stored response is durable — the signal the gateway's response store drops the row on. Sent only after the run's own record commit succeeds, so a stale runner never produces one.

position_key.description: The call whose stored output the run has committed.

CapSync.title: CapSync
CapSync.description: The per-tenant concurrency cap the control plane pushes on plan change. The account is named because the control plane issues this, not a client.

cap.description: The concurrent-run ceiling for the tenant.

CompletionChunk.title: CompletionChunk
CompletionChunk.description: One streamed piece of a completion — an incremental text delta.

text.description: The text produced since the previous chunk.

CompletionTerminal.title: CompletionTerminal
CompletionTerminal.description: The terminal of a completion stream — the final output the run commits.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls the turn requested, if any.

oneOf.description: The model ended its turn.
The output-token ceiling was reached.
The turn stopped to call tools.

ToolCall.description: A tool call the model requested.

arguments.description: The call arguments as a JSON value.

id.description: The identifier a later tool result answers.

GatewayError.title: GatewayError
GatewayError.description: A typed non-delivery outcome, distinct so a client never misreads one for another — an over-cap for a live call, or a transient in-flight for an overdraft.

oneOf.description: The account's plan does not entitle this capability.
The account has no credit or headroom under its caps.
The rate card has no rate for this call, so it cannot be priced.
Another presentation owns the live call; retry after the delay.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before retrying, in milliseconds.

oneOf.description: The provider failed the call; its partial cost is already settled.

GatewayUsage.title: GatewayUsage
GatewayUsage.description: A settled call's metered usage: the rate-card key, its attribution, and the token counts it incurred.

account.description: The account billed for the call.

mode.description: The mode axis of the rate-card key.

operation.description: The operation axis of the rate-card key.

position_key.description: The call this usage settles, scoped to its run.

principal.description: The contributor this usage is attributed to; absent for unattributed automation the platform allows.

quality.description: The quality axis of the rate-card key.

quantities.description: The token counts, one entry per `(dimension, tier)` measured.

CacheTier.description: The tier a metered quantity falls in — the cache-write time-to-live bands, the large-context band, and `none` for an untiered dimension.

oneOf.description: The five-minute cache-write band.
The one-hour cache-write band.
The band for input above the large-context threshold.
No tier applies to this dimension.

Mode.description: Whether a call is interactive or scheduled, one of the rate-card lookup axes.

oneOf.description: An on-demand call a user is waiting on.
A call made by unattended, scheduled work.

Operation.description: The kind of provider call, one of the rate-card lookup axes.

oneOf.description: A chat/text completion call.
An embedding-generation call.

Quality.description: The quality band a call was served at, one of the rate-card lookup axes.

oneOf.description: The default quality band.
Input tokens consumed, including any cached.
Output tokens generated.
Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache.
Input tokens written into the provider's prompt cache.

UsageQuantity.description: One metered quantity on one `(dimension, tier)` axis.

quantity.description: How many units on this axis.

tier.description: The tier the quantity falls in.

GrantSet.title: GrantSet
GrantSet.description: The run-scoped authority the control plane mints at claim: the tenant the run acts for and the tools it may name. An ungranted tool is simply absent from the list; the capability detail behind each name lives in the worker's registry, not on the wire.

account.description: The account the run is scoped to.

principal.description: The initiating principal, absent for account-level automation.

tools.description: The tool names the run is granted.

HoldsReport.title: HoldsReport
HoldsReport.description: The unresolved-holds report a run polls at terminalization and in cancel teardown.

holds.description: The run's holds and where each stands.

HoldEntry.description: One hold of a run and its current disposition.

position_key.description: The call the hold reserves for.

HoldStatus.description: Where one of a run's holds stands. A run is terminal only once none of its holds is `active` or `settle_pending`.

oneOf.description: Reserved, provider not yet dispatched — releasable.
Dispatched; its credit keeps counting and it is not releasable.
Charged at actual usage.
Freed without a charge — the call never reached the provider.

InferenceRequest.title: InferenceRequest
InferenceRequest.description: A managed run's metered call: the call itself and the position key that scopes it, stamped with the contract version the client speaks.

contract_version.description: The gateway contract version this request is built against.

ChatMessage.description: A message in a completion conversation. Each variant carries exactly the fields its role admits, so a user message with tool calls is unrepresentable.

oneOf.description: A user-authored message.
An assistant turn: text, tool calls, or both.

content.description: The assistant's text, empty when the turn was tool calls alone.

tool_calls.description: The tool calls this turn requested, in response order.

oneOf.description: A tool result answering an earlier assistant turn's call.

InferenceCall.description: The call an inference-bracket request carries.

oneOf.description: A streamed completion.

max_tokens.description: The output-token ceiling — the worst-case hold is sized against it.

model.description: The model to serve the call.

response_format.description: The requested response format, when constrained.

stop_sequences.description: Sequences that end generation, when set.

system.description: The system prompt prepended to the conversation, when set.

tools.description: The tools offered to the model.

top_p.description: The nucleus-sampling probability mass, when overridden.

oneOf.description: A batch embedding.

inputs.description: The inputs to embed, one vector per entry.

ResponseFormat.description: The response format a completion requests.

oneOf.description: A JSON response the provider validates for syntax.
A JSON response conforming to a schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the response must conform to.

ToolCall.description: A tool call the model requested.

arguments.description: The call arguments as a JSON value.

id.description: The identifier a later tool result answers.

ToolDefinition.description: A tool offered to the model for one call — the wire projection of a tool's registry descriptor: only what the provider needs to offer it.

input_schema.description: The JSON Schema for the tool's arguments.

name.description: The tool name the model calls.

JobEnqueue.title: JobEnqueue
JobEnqueue.description: A job entering the plane. The account is derived from the presenting credential, so the enqueue carries only the work and its dedup key.

idempotency_key.description: The caller-supplied key that dedups a re-enqueue.

kind.description: What kind of work this is.

priority.description: Ordering within the tenant only; never across tenants.

JobKind.description: The kind of managed job. A closed set the metering path can price and the plane can route; it grows only under a new contract version.

oneOf.description: A graph consolidation / dedup pass.
Scheduled cadence work.
A synthetic runtime-proof job carrying no product semantics.
